summary_1line: Agastya defeats the demon Vatapi, gains wealth from Ilwala, fulfills Lopamudra’s wish, and fathers the powerful sage Dridhasyu.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sage Agastya calmly eats the cooked ram while the demon Ilwala later calls for Vatapi to emerge, only for Agastya to laugh and say he has digested him.
Agastya sits serenely among anxious kings as a thunderous burst of air from his stomach proves the demon Vatapi has been digested.
The sacred river Bhagirathi flows down rocky slopes from Shiva’s matted locks, winding through the land like a shining serpent before meeting the ocean.
